agentNet.hint: Devices use end-to-end encryption. Encrypted-only mode requires Agent-Net on both devices.
agentNet.updateRequired: Install the latest app to use Agent-Net.
agentNet.notConfigured: This relay does not provide Agent-Net yet. Update it or join a V2 relay.
agentNet.failed: Could not change Agent-Net settings. Check the relay connection and try again.

settings.officialHint: Your devices connect through the {{appName}} official relay. When one of your computers uses its own relay, it’s listed here: tap it to join. To join a relay someone shares with you, scan their QR code with your phone’s camera.
settings.selfHostedHint: Your devices connect through your own relay at {{address}}. Sign-in, models, shared tasks, and other services still use {{appName}}.
settings.removedHint: This phone was removed from the relay, or the relay was turned off. Switch back to the official relay, or join again from your computer.
settings.credentialMissingHint: The relay credential isn’t on this phone anymore. Join again from your computer, or switch back to the official relay.
settings.confirmBody: This phone will leave “{{name}}” and use the {{appName}} official relay. To use that relay again, join it again from your computer.
settings.switchFailed: Couldn’t switch back to the official relay. Try again in a moment.
settings.pushUnavailable: While you use your own relay, task notifications from your computers aren’t sent to this phone.
settings.accountSwitchBody: This relay belongs to your account. “{{device}}” lets this phone in automatically, so no share link is needed. While you use your own relay, this phone won’t get task notifications from your computer.
settings.sharedHint: Your devices connect through a relay someone shared with you at {{address}} and reach only your own devices. Sign-in, models, shared tasks, and other services still use {{appName}}.

issue.removedHint: This phone was removed from the relay, or the relay was turned off. You can switch back to the official relay in Settings.

join.title: Join Relay
join.body: After you join, this phone connects to your computers through this relay. Sign-in, models, shared tasks, and other services still use {{appName}}. While you use your own relay, task notifications from your computers aren’t sent to this phone.
join.switchNote: Joining switches this phone from “{{current}}” to this relay.
join.verifyHint: On the computer running the relay, check that it shows these digits, then approve.
join.joinedBody: This phone now connects to your computers through “{{name}}”.
join.signedOut: Sign in to {{appName}} first, then join this relay.
join.invalidLink: This share link isn’t valid or has expired. Create a new one on your computer.
join.cancelled: Joining was cancelled. To join this relay, create a new share link on your computer.
join.accountRequesting: Asking “{{device}}” to let this phone in…
join.openOnComputer: This relay was shared by another account. Open this link on your computer to join. Once your computer joins, this phone sees it under Relay in Settings and can join with one tap.

errors.unreachable: Can’t reach this relay. Make sure your phone and computer are on the same network, or that your phone can open this address.
errors.insecureUnreachable: Can’t reach this relay. Phones can join a relay only over HTTPS. Set up a certificate for the relay on your computer, then create a new share link.
errors.notRelay: This address isn’t a {{appName}} relay. Check the share link.
errors.incompatible: This relay doesn’t work with this version of {{appName}}. Update both the relay and {{appName}}.
errors.accountMismatch: This relay belongs to a different {{appName}} account.
errors.codeInvalid: This share link has expired. Create a new one on your computer.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again later.
errors.rejected: The join request was declined on the computer.
errors.expired: The request timed out while waiting for approval. Create a new share link on your computer.
errors.ownerMismatch: The relay returned a certificate that the owner in the share link didn’t issue. You may be connected to a fake relay, so joining stopped.
errors.failed: Couldn’t join the relay. Try again later.
errors.saveFailed: The request was approved, but the relay credential couldn’t be saved on this phone. Create a new share link on your computer and try again.
errors.credentialUnavailable: This phone doesn’t have a usable relay credential. Join again, or switch back to the official relay in Settings.
errors.ownerUnavailable: “{{device}}” didn’t respond. Make sure {{appName}} is open and online there, or ask for a share link.
errors.relayUnavailable: “{{device}}” is no longer using this relay.
errors.accountDirectoryUnavailable: Can’t reach the {{appName}} account service right now, so your account’s relays can’t be loaded. Try again later, or ask for a share link.
